newsitem.title: CANADA: Imperial Oil raises posted oil prices.
newsitem.headline: Imperial Oil raises posted oil prices.

text.p: Imperial Oil Ltd said it raised the price it would pay for some grades of crude oil by C$12.00/cubic metre or C$1.91/barrel, effective immediately.

The new prices were listed as follows: Edmonton light sweet C$208.00/cubic metre, or C$33.07/barrel Cromer light sour C$201.00/cubic metre, or C$31.96/barrel Bow River at Hardisty C$172.00/cubic metre, or C$27.35/barrel Midale at Cromer C$178.00/cubic metre, or C$28.30/barrel ((Reuters Calgary Bureau (403) 531-1624))
